scope: All existing native-character Lua-referenced plans, with native CSharp contracts inventoried separately; current progress hero summaries. Static only. Legendaryhero read-only inventory.

rules.certainty: Same-action compiler shadow with absent movement/jump; unambiguous direct source-position versus declarative anchor; or source-hash-pinned manually reviewed timing/feature contract. Other missing literals/features are candidates or helper-binding unknown.
rules.branches: Full source inventory is retained. Only exact source-enum dispatch and single-call guards may exclude a row for the action AttackType; all other branches remain possible. No claim that every effect plays on one path.
rules.graphs: Graph presence is counted, graph semantic completeness is not certified.
rules.native: Native C# option fields are signals; native ARM64 recipes are inventoried separately, never assigned a Lua source or sent through Lua compiler probes.
rules.options: Option parsing/metadata alone never closes option branches. Hash-pinned helper schemas bind only explicitly reviewed operations; remaining option fields stay unknown.
rules.guard: Require candidate compiler uniqueness or explicit reviewed precedence; shallow effect-only compilers should reject move/jump/spine/routine operations they cannot bind.
